claim: Moves the grade across the duration of a single shot so a mood can turn without a cut: the frame warms as a memory lands, or drains to desaturated as hope leaves the character. A director reaches for it when the change belongs to the person, not to the edit.
not_visual: This is a transition over time, not a look. Any single frame shows only one point on the ramp, so a still cannot distinguish to_warm from an already-warm preset, and cannot distinguish none from any of the moving options at all. It needs a two-frame or clip comparison, not a capability still.
